items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. This week's financial turmoil includes falling stock prices, companies canceling IPOs, and increased credit default swap spreads, signaling potential problems for major tech firms. The world's pension systems are dealing with a crisis caused by people living longer and having fewer children. Nvidia is shifting from being a chipmaker to an AI industry financier, according to investors. Intel asked for a waiver to use foreign-made robots in US chip factories
